docs/wireframes/accessibility.md << 'EOF' # Accessibility Checklist — Ben Chola (202404172)
## Labels - Every input has android:hint - All icons have contentDescription
## Touch Targets - All buttons ≥ 48dp tall - Minimum 16dp padding between interactive elements
## Text Size - Layouts work at 200% text size - ScrollView + wrap_content for flexibility
## TalkBack - Back button labelled "Navigate up" - Every button has a clear label
## Errors - Shown inline below fields - Preserve typed input after error
## Back Navigation - Every Activity has an up arrow - Predictable parent chain
